headline: Sensex drops 429 points as RBI hikes repo rate to 5.50% amid inflation concerns

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: RBI Monetary Policy Committee hiked the repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.50% to combat price pressure
US 30-year bond yields hit a 24-year high, weighing on global investor sentiment
The Indian Rupee neared record lows against the US Dollar despite the central bank's rate hike
Persistent inflation concerns led to expectations that the government must now handle heavy lifting
whatHappening: The Sensex fell 429 points to close at 22,603 while the Nifty ended near the 22,600 mark
Bharti Airtel shares rose over 2% following the launch of new service plans
Granules India is seeking 180-day exclusivity for its generic version of the cancer drug Ruxolitinib
Bank stocks showed resilience by trimming early losses after the RBI's interest rate decision
summary: Indian markets declined today as the RBI raised the repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.50% to address inflation. The Sensex fell 429 points while the Rupee neared record lows amid surging global bond yields. Bharti Airtel and Granules India remained positive highlights despite the broader selloff triggered by monetary tightening.
